note: In speech the past is mostly the Präteritum: *Ich war gestern zu Hause.*
Also the future: *Ich werde kommen.* = I will come. Its Konjunktiv *würde* + infinitive is *would* for most verbs.
*Könnten Sie mir helfen?* = Could you help me? The other verb goes to the end: *Ich kann gut schwimmen.*

en_presente: have to;have to;has to;have to;have to;have to
note: *nicht müssen* = not have to: *Du musst nicht kommen.* = You don't have to come.
*ich will* = I want, not *I will*. The Konjunktiv II is the same as the Präteritum: *wollte*.

en_past: was supposed to;were supposed to;was supposed to;were supposed to;were supposed to;were supposed to
en_presente: am supposed to;are supposed to;is supposed to;are supposed to;are supposed to;are supposed to
note: *Du solltest…* = You should… (the Konjunktiv II, the same as the Präteritum).

en_past: was allowed to;were allowed to;was allowed to;were allowed to;were allowed to;were allowed to
note: *Darf ich?* = May I? *nicht dürfen* = must not: *Hier darf man nicht rauchen.*
*Ich möchte…* = I would like…: the everyday polite way to ask for something.
For facts. For people and places: *kennen*. *Ich weiß nicht.* = I don't know.
